rows.name: Curative
rows.description: Restorative compounds — herbs, fungi, blood. Selling raw to Magos Biologis or Orders Hospitaller for processing. Raw application = -40 to Medicae; minor effects only, may inflict Corruption or Insanity.

rows.name: Juvenat Compound
rows.description: Life-extension compounds. Must be processed at specialised facilities (rare in Calixis Sector). Toxic or dangerous in raw form.

rows.name: Toxin
rows.description: Venoms and poisons. Limited legitimate markets; high black-market value when unknown to food-tasters. Raw exposure: Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or 1d10 Wounds (ignores Armour & TB).

rows.name: Vivid Accessory
rows.description: Exotic horn/bone/ivory/pelts/dyes for Calixian noble fashion. Driving exotic beasts to demand.

rows.name: Exotic Compound
rows.description: Bizarre Expanse-specific effects — singing flowers, undying carved wood, exotic combat drugs. Hard to categorise; high-risk high-reward.
